root_cause_verification.rationale: The brand-splitting for-loop (originally lines 750-777) that created individual cards per brand with duplicated mall images has been replaced with single-card logic. The new code (lines 747-799) iterates brands only to build summary text for notes_base/notes_local, then creates ONE card per shopping item using the parent mall's image_url. Dead mall_name_base JSX template code was also removed (0 references in both source and deployed HTML).
